note: Third and last inference fix. argmax_token and sample_token subtracted one from the logits index, while training targets byte b at index b and the loss differentiates dlogits(b). Every generated byte was therefore the predecessor of the one the model chose, and 'argmax == target' could never be true, which is why a checkpoint with a teacher-forced nll of 0.002 still reported 0/32 exact match and 0.000 next-byte accuracy. No training: the same bindings checkpoint (run 40899844910, byte 51,069,184) is re-scored through the corrected path.
